style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.dc_adela_arm: A gloved hand peeling off a long woollen glove by candlelight
pictures.dc_adela_arm_2: A grey, near-skeletal forearm with fingers curled in, in a black fur sleeve, in candlelight
pictures.dc_hand_comes: A tattooed, desiccated hand dragging itself over a cypress root toward a campfire in a swamp
pictures.dc_hand_comes_2: The withered hand stopped at the edge of the firelight, fingers spread, magenta threads in the dark
pictures.dc_briggsy: A man rowing out at midnight and dropping a sigil-etched cutlass where two drowned roads cross
pictures.dc_briggsy_2: A many-armed figure of shadow and bone with neon serpent eyes rising over a rowboat on black water
pictures.dc_briggsy_3: Dice on a coffin lid at dawn, the lid closing
pictures.dc_murkwater: Cypress foliage parting on a stilt town of lamplit shacks and rope bridges over black water
pictures.dc_murkwater_2: A fort's purple-and-black flag over a wooden palisade among stilts
pictures.dc_screams: Dead hands coming over a wooden palisade by torchlight
pictures.dc_screams_2: A bloodied sentry falling through a throne-room doorway
pictures.dc_shack: Bottle-buoys glowing in pairs across black water toward a lit shack on stilts
pictures.dc_shack_2: A steel guitar rocking on an empty porch chair
pictures.dc_lagoon: A neon riverboat moored in a mangrove lake, twin funnels coughing magenta flame
pictures.dc_lagoon_2: The same lagoon with the riverboat a broken wreck split in two, faded letters on the hull
pictures.dc_lagoon_3: A coffin boat poled by a chauffeur with copper coins on his eyes and brow
pictures.dc_elias_soul: A withered hand leaping into a dark furnace toward a green mote of light
pictures.dc_elias_soul_2: Neon light returning to the dead eyes of a gaunt waiter
pictures.dc_elias_soul_3: A gaunt waiter in an ill-fitting suit sitting down at last, at rest

pictures.dc_roll_bones_2: A lizardfolk gentleman's grin over a dice table, his crew massed behind him

pictures.dc_all_in_2: Tall windows bursting as swamp water pours into a casino hall

pictures.dc_jack_due_2: The coffin lid slamming shut, a crocodile skull and crossbones cut into it
pictures.dc_jack_due_3: A dark gambling hall, a corpse slumped with a blunderbuss in its hands, eyes wide
